description: Use this when someone asks which stylists or hairdressers work at their salon or can be booked, or which stylist to book a client with. Returns up to 100 hairdresser ids and display names from the organization that owns the salon (no contact details or schedules). Not for stylists' days off.

salonId.description: Id of one of the user's salons, as the salon list returns it (24 lowercase hex characters)

name: list_providers

providers.description: Ids and display names of organization members with the hairdresser role; roles are organization-wide, not per salon. The ids are the ones the salon's public booking page already shows. Contact details, avatar URLs, role records, schedules and organization data are excluded.

id.description: The id book_appointment takes in providerIds

title: List stylists who take appointments
